evals.prompt: Install this audited coding skill universally. Pi, Codex, and OpenClaw can already discover ~/.agents, while Claude and Hermes need explicit exposure.
evals.expected_output: Should make one canonical per-skill source under ~/.agents, link only Claude and Hermes explicitly, preserve native roots, back up conflicts, and verify discovery without whole-root symlinks.
expectations: Does not create redundant Pi, Codex, or OpenClaw copies
Creates explicit Claude and Hermes links
Never replaces an entire skills root

evals.prompt: Matt's skills repo changed on main. Pull it automatically every night and make every harness use whatever is newest.
evals.expected_output: Should reject automatic activation, keep the current pin, and prescribe fetch, diff, dependency and side-effect audit, evaluations, bounded pilot, explicit pin move, and rollback retention.
expectations: Requires evaluations and a bounded pilot
Retains the prior snapshot for rollback

evals.prompt: Copy this Pi-only browser skill into Claude, Hermes, Codex, and OpenClaw so everything has the same list.
evals.expected_output: Should classify the skill as harness-native, leave it Pi-local, and explain that equal catalogs are less important than compatible behavior.
expectations: Does not distribute merely for catalog symmetry
